title.zh: Solana Debuts Institutional Settlement Standard With J.P. Morgan Input
title.en: Solana Debuts Institutional Settlement Standard With J.P. Morgan Input

current_state.zh: The Solana Foundation launched Solana DvP, an MIT-licensed open-source escrow program giving financial institutions a standardized API for atomic delivery-versus-payment settlement, developed with input from J.P. Morgan.
current_state.en: The Solana Foundation launched Solana DvP, an MIT-licensed open-source escrow program giving financial institutions a standardized API for atomic delivery-versus-payment settlement, developed with input from J.P. Morgan.
